title: SWF: PlaceObject2 color transform (color effects)
description: Implement color transform encoding for PlaceObject2 (tag 26). When a SymbolInstance has a colorEffect (tint, alpha, brightness, advanced), encode the correct CXFormWithAlpha in the PlaceObject2 tag. Support: alpha (only), tint (RGB multiply + add), advanced (all 8 values). Tests verify the CXFormWithAlpha bytes match expected encoding for each effect type.
